summary_1line: Devotees of Siva—including Nandanar, Jnana Sambandhi, and Siriyala—demonstrate intense devotion through miracles, trials, and divine recognition.

image_candidates.scene_text: Nandanar stands before the shrine of Nataraja as a sacred flame suddenly flares up and engulfs him in radiant light.
Nanda walks into his fields at dawn and finds the entire crop mysteriously ripened and ready for harvest overnight.
Siriyala and his wife serve a meal of their sacrificed son to a wandering ascetic who sits calmly awaiting the dish.
